map.网格渐变由多个径向渐变叠加构成：拖动预览上的圆点调整各色团的位置，改动颜色即时重: A mesh gradient is several radial gradients overlaid: drag the dots in the preview to move each colour blob and recolour instantly. Copy the CSS, download an 800×500 PNG, and check overlay-text readability against every colour stop with the WCAG contrast formula (worst case reported). The PNG is drawn on Canvas with a farthest-corner radius approximation, close to the browser's CSS rendering but not pixel-identical.

map.mesh 和线性渐变有什么区别？: What is the difference between mesh and a linear gradient?
map.线性渐变沿单一方向过渡，mesh 用多个径向色团叠加、方向各异，过渡更自然，常用: A linear gradient transitions along one direction; a mesh overlays several radial colour blobs in different directions, giving a more natural transition and often used for posters and large backgrounds. This page outputs standard layered CSS radial-gradients you can paste into a project stylesheet.
map.两种色对比度不够会提示吗？: Will it warn me when two colours lack contrast?
map.会。页面按 WCAG 公式计算叠加文字与每个色标的对比度，报告最差的一处并给出等: Yes. The page computes the contrast between overlay text and every colour stop using the WCAG formula, reports the worst case and its level; below 4.5:1 it turns red and suggests changing the colour or enlarging the text.
map.PNG 与浏览器预览完全一致吗？: Is the PNG identical to the browser preview?
map.不完全一致。PNG 由 Canvas 按 farthest-corner 半径近: Not exactly. The PNG is drawn on Canvas with a farthest-corner radius approximation; blob positions and colours match, but edge transitions may differ slightly from CSS rendering. For pixel-perfect output, take a screenshot or use the CSS.
map.会保存或上传我的内容吗？: Does it save or upload my content?
map.不会。颜色、位置与导出全部在浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器、不写入远端存储。: No. Colours, positions and export all happen locally in the browser — nothing is uploaded or written to remote storage.
